name: Dive in
summary: Show the one thing that matters inside a busy frame: a number on a dashboard, a repo name, a face in a crowd.

data.about: Zooms in while sliding toward a point of the frame (`at`), so an off-centre detail ends up centred and big.
data.avoid: A detail too small for the source resolution at the end scale; when the detail is already centred (use a zoom).
